description.zh:
是否开启资源栈删除保护，取值：
- Enabled：开启资源栈删除保护。
- Disabled（默认）：关闭资源栈删除保护。此时支持通过控制台或API（DeleteStack）释放资源栈。

> 嵌套资源栈删除保护与根资源栈一致。
description.en:
Indicates whether stack deletion protection is enabled. Valid values:

- Enabled: enables the stack deletion protection.

- Disabled (default): Resource stack deletion protection is Disabled. You can use the console or API(DeleteStack) to release the stack resources.

> The deletion of nested stacks is the same as the root stack.

description.zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
资源栈ID。
  
嵌套资源栈的删除保护属性由根资源栈决定，始终与根资源栈一致，且无法被修改。
description.en:
The ID of the stack.

The delete protection attribute of a nested stack is determined by the root stack and remains unchanged from the root stack.

title.zh: 修改资源栈的删除保护属性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros set-deletion-protection --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --deletion-protection Enabled --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
